name: handpass6-parser-misreads
source: hand pass 6 owner console turns 08:54:05-08:54:41 and 13:52:32-13:53:01 (contact_respond_id 437264483, 17 Sep 2026). Case 1: 'how about DO?' then 'can show both?' must return BOTH the sales-order and delivery-order outstanding SECTIONS, not a bare DO line list - measured pre-fix (08:54:41 real reply): a numbered DO line list ('1. *DO Number:* REP202609-0301...'), no *Sales order outstanding* section at all. Case 1 uses `contact: '437264483'`: confirmed by running, the default 440987225 gets 'Sales order figures are not enabled for your account.' (no `sales_orders.outstanding` row in `contact_field_reveals`), which is a permission gap, not the parser-misread this case targets; 437264483 holds the grant. Case 2 reproduces 13:53:01's own bug ('for 7' resolving to an unrelated BRACD/IBWC/JOB roster instead of position 7 of the SAME ten-item SRTWC286 family, i.e. SRTWC286-SH-150). Re-pinned 17 Sep 2026 (tester 24, coder 23's R-a ruling `1a065da1c`): the brief's original precondition ('check stock srtwc286' settling a ten-code carry, then 'i want stock, incoming and PO' to arm a roster over it) was itself the roster-on-a-settled-carry-domain-switch behaviour R-a retires, so that step could never legitimately arm a roster to answer 'for 7' against. Swapped to 'incoming for srtwc286' (same `narrow_to_code` exception used in `handpass6-answered-roster-does-not-linger`) to arm the SAME ten-item, same-order roster directly (confirmed live, 17 Sep 2026: position 7 = SRTWC286-SH-150, identical order to the retired precondition), then 'okay how about stock, incoming and PO for 7' resolves position 7 within THAT roster - the actual defect under test.
